name: ceh-evaluation
description: CEH evaluation: evaluate a Claude Code skill or plugin you just wrote against derived, evidence-based criteria — structural integrity, triggering accuracy, content quality, and behavioral lift — then loop fix/re-run until a readiness gate passes. Includes a lite dev-loop variant that skips behavioral lift for a cheap sanity check. Self-contained; treats skill-creator and plugin-dev as optional cross-checks, not authorities.
